subject: Program-address-identifier
notes: cite.py --check 8.4.3.13.4 'creates a unique data item of class pointer and category program-pointer' OK (GR1). a) identifier content: emitted as `(read).Trim()` into ProgramRegistry.EntryOf at statement time; b) literal value decoded at bind (STRINGLIT/HEXLIT/NATLIT/concatenation); c) prototype -> its externalized name. Class pointer / category program-pointer: the value is a ProgramPointer; `IF ADDRESS OF PROGRAM "PAISUB" = ADDRESS OF PROGRAM "paisub"` -> REL-EQ (probe ok2); CALL through it runs the program (pb549 golden SUB/SUB/SUB/PROTO). 8.3.2.2 2a (COBOL convention: the name is treated as a COBOL word) - lower-case content 'paisub' locates PAISUB; a national identifier and N"PAISUB" both locate it (probe ok2). The identifier arm's category screen is defective for group/alphabetic items, but that is SR1's rule and is recorded there. .Trim() also strips LEADING spaces - inside the 8.3.2.2 implementor-defined mapping, not a divergence. [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the program-pointer family; absent from COBOL-85 - Annex E covers only 2014->2023, the introduction is the 2002 address-identifier; probe: --std 85 draws COBOL0900)]
